answer: Require every new identity to post a time-locked stake that only matures after a dawn review window, during which its early outputs are mirror-checked against established peers: near-identical submissions flag a shared operator. The stake is slashed if the mirror check fires, and the signal that unlocks full participation is a sustained record of distinct, accepted work. A sybil farmer must lock fresh capital per identity and produce genuinely distinct work for each, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes plus a thousand work streams, not one script run once.
